items.exampleEn: The shop's guard dog looked unfriendly, so we stayed away.
items.exampleZh: 那家店的看門狗看起來很不友善，所以我們離牠遠遠的。

items.exampleEn: He carelessly spilled coffee on the report.
items.exampleZh: 他粗心地把咖啡灑在報告上。

items.exampleEn: After the long flight, I walked around in a daze.
items.exampleZh: 長途飛行後，我恍恍惚惚地走來走去。

items.exampleEn: My brother is uninterested in sports.
items.exampleZh: 我的兄弟對運動不感興趣。

items.exampleEn: He never shares his innermost secrets with anyone.
items.exampleZh: 他從不跟任何人分享內心深處的秘密。

items.exampleEn: The taxi driver was talkative and told us many stories.
items.exampleZh: 計程車司機很健談，跟我們講了很多故事。

items.exampleEn: Dreams may show our subconscious wishes.
items.exampleZh: 夢可能會顯示我們潛意識的願望。

items.exampleEn: You'll be overjoyed to hear this news.
items.exampleZh: 聽到這個消息，你一定會欣喜若狂。
items.glossZh: 欣喜若狂的；非常高興的

items.sentenceEn: The overjoyed fans ran onto the field.
items.sentenceZh: 欣喜若狂的球迷衝進了球場。

items.audioEn: She carelessly left her phone on the bus, and now she can't find it.
items.audioZh: 她粗心地把手機留在公車上，現在找不到了。
options: Someone took it on the bus
She forgot it on the bus

items.sentenceEn: The talkative boy never stops asking questions.
items.sentenceZh: 那個愛說話的男孩總是問個不停。

items.sentenceEn: The bright lights left me in a daze.
items.sentenceZh: 刺眼的燈光讓我一陣恍惚。

items.stemEn: The students looked ____ during the long lesson; some were even sleeping.
items.stemZh: 學生們在冗長的課堂上看起來興趣缺缺，有些甚至睡著了。

items.stemEn: When she heard that she had won, she was ____.
items.stemZh: 她聽到自己贏了時，欣喜若狂。

items.passageEn: When Mia joined our class, she seemed unfriendly and uninterested in talking to anyone. I'm talkative, so I tried to chat with her every day. One day, I carelessly dropped her notebook, and some pages fell out. I saw that she had written her innermost thoughts there: she missed her old friends and felt lonely. It was an awkward moment. I said sorry, and she stood in a daze for a moment. Then she smiled. She told me that being quiet was a subconscious way to protect herself. Now we are best friends, and I was overjoyed when she invited me to her birthday party.
items.passageZh: Mia 剛轉來我們班時，看起來很冷淡，對和任何人說話都不感興趣。我很愛說話，所以每天都試著和她聊天。有一天，我粗心地弄掉了她的筆記本，有幾頁掉了出來。我看到她在裡面寫下了內心深處的想法：她很想念以前的朋友，覺得很孤單。那是個尷尬的時刻。我向她道歉，她茫然地站了一會兒，接著就笑了。她告訴我，保持安靜是她下意識保護自己的方式。現在我們是最好的朋友，她邀請我參加她的生日派對時，我欣喜若狂。

questions.questionZh: 作者在筆記本裡看到了什麼？
options: Mia 很想念以前的朋友
Mia 寫給作者的一封長長的道歉信
Mia 畫的很多張可愛的動物圖片
Mia 下週要考試的所有重點筆記

questions.questionZh: Mia 說她為什麼很安靜？
options: 因為老師叫她不要說話

items.promptZh: 我妹妹喝了咖啡以後就變得很多話。
referenceEn: My sister becomes very talkative after she drinks coffee.
After drinking coffee, my sister gets really talkative.
rubricZh: 用 talkative 表示「多話的；健談的」

items.promptZh: 他考上大學時欣喜若狂。
referenceEn: He was overjoyed when he got into college.
He was overjoyed to hear that the university had accepted him.
rubricZh: 用 overjoyed 表示「欣喜若狂的」
